in_hebrew.name: Haag
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Hedge or enclosure
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Haag הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old High German word 'hag', meaning 'hedge' or 'enclosure'. This name may have been given to children born in rural areas, or those whose families farmed or worked in agriculture.
